ONE-PAGE BOOK (reader.tsx line 202): the record write at the last page needs book.pages.length > 1, so a one-page book writes the record only through the end view, while the decodable writes at its last page when lastPage > 0 (decodable.tsx line 225). A one-page decodable therefore never writes the record. The gate row 13 evidence names done_marks_found_after=1 for the decodable, and the book write is quoted from the app walk, not from a measured row. The shipped w01 holds 8 pages in both books, so the shipped data does not show the case. The files did not change in this delta. Low.

LANDSCAPE CAP (look.css lines 869 to 879): the decodable picture cap of 84 px sits inside the @media (max-height: 500px) block that opens at line 800, so the cap follows the viewport height and not the width, and it reaches every viewport of 500 px height or less, including a short portrait such as 390x400. The phase3-browser-gate.sh holds a parallel row for the song video at a short portrait viewport, and no row holds that shape for the decodable picture. The 48 px targets hold: the sentence word buttons keep min-height 48px and min-width 48px at lines 591 to 593, and the tricky-word buttons keep min-height 48px at lines 904 to 907. The picture is not a tap target. The cap is a side effect of item 4 that the council did not ask for, and the plan and the Green log both name it. Low.

DEFAULT SONG ROW FLOOR (look-phase2-browser-gate.sh lines 1647 to 1675): the row 14 default song row reads zero active rows and zero filled rows as a pass, and it prints no count of the lyric rows it inspected, so a missing lyric list also passes that row. Two other checks in the same gate cover that case: the row 1 capture requires opened.activeLine === 1 for the song screen, and the C1 case in look-council-r3.test.tsx line 218 asserts that the rendered row count equals the shipped line count. Low.

SPEAKER BUTTON DOM QUERY (speaker-button.tsx line 30): the button finds its audio element with event.currentTarget.parentElement?.querySelector("audio") instead of a ref. A server component cannot pass a ref to a client component, and the span holds one audio element today, so the query returns the right element. A second audio element inside the same span would make the query pick the first one. Low.
